item.title: VanEck Names XRP Ledger in $45B Corporate Blockchain Opportunity
item.summary: The XRP Ledger (XRPL) has been identified by asset manager VanEck as a potential contender in the expanding corporate blockchain market, with the network appearing across three financial sectors that the firm estimates could represent a combined $45 billion in annual revenue opportunities by 2030.
